**Lineage.** Opened as "The adversarial review, in places" (D-WORKFLOW-083, D-WORKFLOW-102). On 2026-10-22 the maintainer widened it into a renovation program (D-WORKFLOW-181, on `feature/m6-renovation-plan-346` until merged): modernize, standards and best practices, bugs, package currency, efficiency (computation, memory, the player's time), dead ends, clarity and structure. Still in slices, progressively, beside feature work, never one broad sweep. Fable plans; a model such as Opus 5.5 executes a slice from its brief. Planning, the division of work, the definition of work items and every roadmap change stay in the coordinator lane; a work lane executes and does not plan (D-WORKFLOW-189, 2026-10-23). The plan for the plan is `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` (#346).

**Acceptance.** Every slice `docs/reviews/order.md` names has its audit folder under `docs/audits/` with the review depth its issue recorded, `tools/lint-audit-artifacts` PASS, and a punch-list issue whose items are resolved through Phase 7 or accepted by a register row; no release waits on the renovation: a finding that is a defect is a bug issue and holds or clears a release as every bug does (D-WORKFLOW-187, refining D-WORKFLOW-102). The milestone closes when the order's last slice closes and `tools/renovation-drift` shows no closed slice with unreviewed changes.

Punch list of the M6 T30 audit (#677): the standalone emulators, 543 paths, `reviewed-at: c7e3dfcc87` (the slice's bytes equal to `next`'s `8ebaf8daad`). The audit is `docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-emulators-standalone/` on `feature/m6-emulators-standalone-677`. 41 items: 0 critical, 2 high, 16 medium, 23 low. Depth: Extended (GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Argon, the latter on a trimmed packet, D-WORKFLOW-195).

## Executive summary

**The two High findings:**

- A `.scummvm` file in the ROM library runs as shell, as root, at launch (PL-007, #859; proven on the guest).
- Start scripts delete a real directory before linking it; a save state made in DuckStation from the Tools launcher is deleted by the next game launch (PL-012, #863; proven on the guest).

**The exit hotkey does nothing** in DuckStation (every image; its psx default on the VM), OpenBOR, Mupen64Plus's simple core and the hatarisa route (PL-001 to PL-004). **The previous RetroAchievements session stays signed in** in five achievements scripts (PL-009). Six of the defects are fixed upstream after our base (class 1 with the base merge). `portaudio`'s primary source URL is dead, and ROCKNIX's mirror covers it (#849, Low).

**Time to play** (`runemu.sh` to the emulator, n = 3): gzdoom's first frame 1.03-3.13 s with Freedoom; ScummVM's first draw 0.64-1.08 s; ppsspp, x64sc and DuckStation 0.52-0.67 s to the process. Not the interface's press (an SSH launch).

## Acceptance-criteria scorecard (#677, at stage D)

Met: criteria 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 (21 = 21) and 14 (three guest cycles); the lint `PASS pre-issue artifacts`; open for later stages: 1 (05 lands with this issue), 2 (resolution), 4, 5, 13, 15, 16.

## The items

Each checkbox is ticked from its acceptance artifact when its Phase 7 outcome is recorded in `05-punch-list.md` (resolved with its commit, deferred to a named issue, or withdrawn with its reason).

- [x] **PL-001** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#853): DuckStation's kill target `AppRun.wrapped` names no process, so the exit hotkey does nothing in DuckStation on every image. Acceptance: On the guest, a launch of duckstation-sa through runemu.sh writes a kill target that `killall` ends: the emulator process is gone after `killall $(cat /tmp/.process-kill-data)` (the G7 shape).
- [x] **PL-002** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#854): `start_OpenBOR.sh` names no kill target, so the exit hotkey does nothing in OpenBOR on every image. Acceptance: On the guest, during an OpenBOR launch through runemu.sh, /tmp/.process-kill-data names OpenBOR and `killall $(cat /tmp/.process-kill-data)` ends the process.
- [x] **PL-003** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#855): Mupen64Plus's kill target misses the simple core's binary `mupen64plus-simple`. Acceptance: start_mupen64plus.sh's kill data names mupen64plus-simple; on the guest a renamed-binary substitute named mupen64plus-simple is ended by the written target (G6's shape), the substitute named in the tick.
- [x] **PL-004** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#856): The table's `atarist`/`hatarisa` route asks for `start_hatarisa.sh`, which no image has; the script installed sets no kill target. Acceptance: On the guest, `runemu.sh <st> -Patarist --core=hatarisa --emulator=hatarisa` reaches hatarisa (no exit 127), and its kill data ends the process.
- [x] **PL-005** (Medium, Q6, Interaction Defect) (#857): GENERIC_X64's table offers five standalone emulators its image does not build, two of them as the nds and saturn defaults. Acceptance: tools/t30-routes.py over a regenerated GENERIC_X64 table reports 0 routes with no script among the members' emulators.
- [x] **PL-006** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#858): Zipped N64 ROMs do not launch in standalone Mupen64Plus: `unzip -Zl -1` under busybox; the `.zip` test matches any name with 'zip' in it. Acceptance: On the guest, a zipped .z64 reaches the emulator with the archive's member as its ROM argument; a ROM named 'Zippy Race.z64' is not unzipped (the command line in exec.log).
- [x] **PL-007** (High, Q3, Security) (#859): `start_scummvm.sh` runs a `.scummvm` file's content through `eval`, as root. Acceptance: On the guest, the crafted .scummvm of G3 launches ScummVM (or its error) and leaves no /tmp/t30-svm-injected; Flight of the Amazon Queen's .scummvm still launches (G15).
- [x] **PL-008** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#860): gzdoom's arguments pass through `echo | xargs`: a WAD path with an apostrophe never launches, one with a space is split. Acceptance: On the guest, Freedoom renamed `Free Doom's Gate.wad` reaches its first frame (G14's harness), as does the plain name.
- [x] **PL-009** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#861): Five achievements scripts keep the previous RetroAchievements session when the switch is on and the token empty, and leave the token at rest when it is off. Acceptance: The G9 fixture (switch 1, token empty, a synthetic old token pre-seeded) leaves 0 old-token lines and a disabled flag for each of the four scripts.
- [x] **PL-010** (Low, Q2, Bug) (#861): Four achievements scripts test `[ ! ${enabled} = 1 ]` unquoted, so an empty key falls through as enabled. Acceptance: The four scripts with the switch key unset take their disabled branch (a fixture run, rc 1).
- [x] **PL-011** (Low, Q3, Bug) (#862): Eleven comparisons are written as redirections (`>`, `<>`): each creates or truncates a file in /storage and tests only non-emptiness (one always fails). Acceptance: `grep -E '\[ [^]]*[^-]( <>| >| <) [^]]*\]'` over the 55 shell files prints nothing; the fixture over each fixed line creates no file.
- [x] **PL-012** (High, Q3, State) (#863): Start scripts delete a real directory before linking it, with no copy: a save state made in DuckStation from the Tools launcher is deleted by the next game launch. Acceptance: The G8 fixture keeps the synthetic card (found once under the target) and replaces the directory by the link; a failed copy leaves the directory in place.
- [x] **PL-013** (Low, Q4, Package Currency) (#849): `portaudio`'s primary source URL is dead (404); an empty-cache build succeeds through ROCKNIX's source mirror. Acceptance: #849's criteria.
- [x] **PL-014** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#864): NanoBoyAdvance creates a directory named `gba_bios.bin` where the player's BIOS file belongs. Acceptance: A fixture run of the fixed script on a tree without the BIOS leaves no gba_bios.bin; with a fixture of the old directory, it is removed.
- [x] **PL-015** (Low, Q3, Bug) (#871): amiberry's script deletes the resolution keys it means to set, matches 'AGA|CD32' literally, and overwrites the player's configs every launch. Acceptance: A fixture of the fixed lines over the shipped seed writes gfx_width=<w> and gfx_height=<h>.
- [x] **PL-016** (Low, Q3, Bug): Supermodel receives all its options as one argument. Acceptance: The base merge brings upstream's array form (q4a's 0c43a50420 row resolved).
- [x] **PL-017** (Low, Q3, Bug) (#871): mednafen passes `-vb.3dmode` the CPU-emulation value, and traces every launch with `set -x`. Acceptance: start_mednafen.sh:175 passes ${DM}; no set -x.
- [x] **PL-018** (Low, Q3, Security) (#871): yabasanshiro's first launch `eval`s a pad's self-reported name. Acceptance: A fixture of the fixed lines with a device name holding `'; touch /tmp/x; '` creates no /tmp/x.
- [x] **PL-019** (Medium, Q3, Security) (#865): gopher64 receives the RetroAchievements password on its command line, unquoted; an empty password makes the ROM path its value. Acceptance: A fixture of the fixed lines with an empty password and with one holding a space prints the ROM path as the last argument and the password as one argument.
- [x] **PL-020** (Medium, Q3, Security) (#866): melonDS's script writes the RetroAchievements password in plain text into melonDS.ini every launch, with an incomplete sed escape. Acceptance: A fixture of set_key with a value holding `|` and `\` writes it intact.
- [x] **PL-021** (Low, Q2, Standards) (#870): PPSSPP's and SkyEmu's token files are written with the default umask, not by temp and rename (PPSSPP's twice). Acceptance: After the fixture, ppsspp_retroachievements.dat has mode 0600 and was written once.
- [x] **PL-022** (Low, Q6, Interaction Defect) (#857): The AdvanceMame (cps1 to cps3) and moonlight rows have no script on any image. Acceptance: tools/t30-routes.py over the regenerated tables: no AdvanceMame or moonlight route without its script.
- [x] **PL-023** (Low, Q7, Renovation): Dolphin's gc and wii scripts share 282 lines, and `-v $GRENDERER` is overwritten before use. Acceptance: The two scripts source one shared file; diff of each against its shared part is the system-specific half only.
- [x] **PL-024** (Low, Q6, Renovation): Dead code: psp_save_mover.sh (no caller), cheevos_duckstation.sh (not called), six unused password reads, touchHLE's echo of an unset variable. Acceptance: git grep finds no caller for any removed file; pkgcheck and bash -n pass.
- [x] **PL-025** (Low, Q4, Package Currency): `aethersx2-sa` is deleted upstream for licensing; every row goes with the base merge (nothing removed; save-state compatibility with ARMSX2 not shown). Acceptance: After the base merge, git ls-files projects/ROCKNIX/packages/emulators/standalone/aethersx2-sa prints nothing and SM8550's table offers no aethersx2 route.
- [x] **PL-026** (Low, Q4, Package Currency): Pins behind their projects: DuckStation, ScummVM, VICE, BigPEmu (and dsperate, azahar with the base merge). Acceptance: 04 § Q4 (b): each bump proposed has an issue, or the recipe states why it is pinned.
- [x] **PL-027** (Low, Q4, Package Currency): supermodel-sa and yabasanshiro-sa pin commits that are on no default branch. Acceptance: Each recipe's comment names the branch its PKG_VERSION is on.
- [x] **PL-028** (Low, Q5, Renovation) (#871): Mupen64Plus copies every ROM into tmpfs before launch and runs with --configdir in /tmp, losing in-emulator settings. Acceptance: A launch of an unzipped ROM leaves no copy under /tmp/mupen64plus; a setting changed in the emulator survives the next launch.
- [x] **PL-029** (Low, Q3, Bug) (#871): flycast's script moves data then links over a path the move may have made a directory; its quoted `kill -9 "$(pidof gptokeyb)"` kills no helper when there are two. Acceptance: On the guest, two launches leave /storage/roms/dreamcast/data a link to bios/dc and kill only the launch's gptokeyb.
- [x] **PL-030** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#867): Steam's launcher exits before its callers' cleanup, so an x86 Steam session leaves systemd-binfmt stopped and dual-screen state on. Acceptance: A fixture sourcing start_steam.sh with stub launch functions records steam_dual_screen_end and the binfmt start after steam_launch_bigpicture returns.
- [x] **PL-031** (Low, Q3, Bug) (#871): A Steam desktop entry's URI and `-silent` reach Steam as one argument. Acceptance: A fixture prints the URI and -silent as two arguments.
- [x] **PL-032** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#868): DraStic's binary is copied to /storage once and run from there, so an OS update's DraStic never reaches an existing device. Acceptance: A fixture with a stale /storage copy and a newer image copy runs the newer one; the player's drastic.cfg is unchanged.
- [x] **PL-033** (Medium, Q3, Bug) (#869): Dolphin's face-button swap is re-applied to the retained Hotkeys.ini on every launch, so its bindings alternate. Acceptance: Two consecutive launch preparations with FACE_SWAP=yes leave Hotkeys.ini byte-identical.
- [x] **PL-034** (Medium, Q3, Security): melonDS's TOML, regenerated every launch, may hold the RetroAchievements password and token outside the backup's blanking. Acceptance: The patch's config writer is shown not to write RetroAchievements.Password or .Token to the TOML, or backuptool blanks them there.
- [x] **PL-035** (Medium, Q3, State): The exit hotkey kills every standalone emulator with SIGKILL, so nothing an emulator writes at shutdown is written. Acceptance: For each emulator on the guest, a save written at exit survives the hotkey's kill, or the emulator is shown to write nothing at exit.
- [x] **PL-036** (Low, Q3, Bug) (#871): OpenBOR's script empties /storage/openbor/Paks on every launch. Acceptance: On the guest, a real file in /storage/openbor/Paks survives an OpenBOR launch.
- [x] **PL-037** (Low, Q1, Renovation): DuckStation's own achievements are disabled on every launch (upstream's workaround), and cheevos_duckstation.sh is dead. Acceptance: start_duckstation.sh's line 131 carries its reason, or is removed with a guest proof of DuckStation's own sign-in.
- [x] **PL-038** (Low, Q3, Bug) (#871): Xemu's, melonDS's and Dolphin's scripts overwrite or delete the player's settings on every launch. Acceptance: A setting changed in xemu.toml, melonDS.toml and Dolphin's GameSettings survives the next launch preparation (fixtures).
- [x] **PL-039** (Low, Q2, Standards) (#870): Sign-in values enter sed unescaped; sections are bounded by a blank line; ARMSX2's first section omits three keys. Acceptance: The G9 fixture with a token holding / & and a backslash writes it intact into each emulator's config.
- [x] **PL-040** (Low, Q3, Bug) (#871): ScummVM's first-run seed is unreachable, and generated entry names are not confined to the games folder. Acceptance: On the guest, a launch with /storage/.config/scummvm absent seeds it from /usr/config/scummvm.
